findings.detail: The adoptable launcher source is exactly the author commit d70bb370f3: two unset PYTHONNOUSERSITE changes, with no other production-source delta.

Revised controls invoke the actual production launcher path, clear the poisoned outer startup key in both child-shell interpreter calls, preserve private origins/schemas/custody bindings and an unrelated variable, reach the body once, and return exit 17 exactly.
The poisoned-manifest control fails before the body, with zero body invocation and no body log or exit evidence.
The test exercises the real launcher and existing guards rather than mirroring implementation; review-head changes are limited to the focused test file and all old source outside it is unchanged.

The direct Remotion probe rejects the poisoned environment and accepts the supported clear environment. Live frozen-tuple body/provider/install/browser/full-suite/production-request evidence remains intentionally unclaimed.
